metal_color.金: a fine jewelry photo where the metal setting is warm yellow gold or rose gold, with a golden or pinkish-gold hue on the band prongs and mount
metal_color.銀: a fine jewelry photo where the metal setting is cool white silver white gold or platinum, with a bright silvery or cool grey-white tone on the band prongs and mount

color.紅: a fine jewelry photo dominated by vivid red color from ruby or red garnet gemstone
color.粉: a fine jewelry photo with pink or rose color from pink sapphire or pink tourmaline gemstone
color.黃: a fine jewelry photo with yellow or orange color from yellow sapphire citrine or spessartite garnet gemstone
color.綠: a fine jewelry photo with green color from emerald tsavorite or green tourmaline gemstone
color.藍: a fine jewelry photo with blue or teal color from sapphire tanzanite aquamarine or paraiba tourmaline gemstone
color.紫: a fine jewelry photo with purple or violet color from amethyst or purple sapphire gemstone
color.白: a fine jewelry photo with white colorless or near-colorless gemstone such as diamond moonstone or white opal
color.彩: a fine jewelry photo with multicolor rainbow iridescent black gray or brown gemstone such as opal tourmaline black diamond or labradorite

category.戒指: a product photo of a finger ring — a piece of jewelry with a circular metal band sized to fit around a finger (inner diameter 17-21mm, finger-width hole). Includes solitaire rings, halo rings, eternity rings, cocktail rings, cluster rings, band rings. The band wraps completely around and you wear it on a finger. Shot from above, angled, or on a ring display cone. NOT an earring (earrings are tiny, under 3cm, attach to an ear lobe). NOT a hoop earring. NOT a brooch. NOT a bracelet.
category.手鏈: a product photo of a bracelet worn on the WRIST — including tennis bracelets with a row of stones, thin delicate chain bracelets, bangle bracelets, charm bracelets, or link bracelets. The piece encircles the wrist, length 15-20cm. NOT a necklace (necklaces are much longer, 40cm+). NOT a ring.
category.項鍊: a product photo of either (A) a complete NECKLACE worn around the neck — full chain laid out in a U or V shape, necklace on a neck display bust, or a pendant clearly attached to a chain, total length 40-80cm — OR (B) a STANDALONE PENDANT CHARM displayed alone without any chain — a small decorative piece (1-4cm) with a visible bail loop or hook at the very top for hanging, shown isolated. NOT a bracelet (bracelets encircle the wrist, 15-20cm). NOT a ring (no finger hole). NOT an earring.
category.耳釘: a product photo of earrings — very small jewelry pieces (typically 0.5-3cm) designed to attach to an EAR LOBE or ear cartilage via a post pin, wire hook, or clip. Includes: small studs, drop earrings, dangle earrings, hoop earrings, ear climbers. One or two matching pieces shown. Earrings are MUCH SMALLER than rings and have no finger-sized hole — a hoop earring is small (under 4cm) with a thin wire, not a wide metal band. NOT a finger ring (rings are larger with a wide band). NOT a brooch.
category.胸針: a product photo of a brooch — a flat decorative badge pinned to a clothing lapel or jacket, displayed lying flat on a surface or display card. The piece has a pointed pin-clasp on the back for fastening to fabric. Common designs: flower clusters, butterfly, leaf, bow, star, or animal figure made of metal with gemstone accents. The brooch lays flat like a badge and does not encircle any body part.
category.其他: a product photo of a hair accessory decorated with gemstones or metal — such as a jeweled hair pin, decorative hair comb, ornate hair clip, or tiara headband — a wearable accessory for styling hair, photographed on a flat surface or display stand

style.無鑽: a photo of jewelry with ZERO diamonds anywhere — no sparkle on the band, no pave, no halo, no side stones, no diamond accents at all — only a single colored gemstone on a completely plain smooth metal band with no stone setting other than the center stone prongs

style.輕奢: a photo of jewelry with clearly visible small round white diamonds pave-set on the band, shoulder diamonds, a diamond halo ring around the center stone, or multiple rows of accent diamonds — noticeably sparkly diamond accents surrounding the main gemstone
style.奢華: a photo of jewelry completely covered in diamonds — full pave setting with diamonds covering the entire band and setting, eternity style with diamonds all the way around, wall-to-wall diamond coverage leaving almost no visible plain metal

setting_amount.少: a photo of jewelry with simple minimal setting — plain solitaire with prongs, or a center stone with a small number of accent diamonds only on the band shoulders or simple channel-set side stones, clean understated design where the main gemstone is clearly the dominant focus
setting_amount.正常: a photo of jewelry with moderate setting work — a center gemstone surrounded by a full halo of diamonds, pave diamonds spread across a significant portion of the band, multiple rows of accent stones, or side stones extending well beyond the shoulder area
setting_amount.多: a photo of jewelry with heavy elaborate setting work — full pave diamonds covering nearly all metal surfaces, eternity rings or bands fully set with stones all around, complex multi-tier or layered designs, ornate frame or cage-style settings enclosing the stone, micro-pave everywhere, or pieces where the metal structure is almost entirely hidden under dense stone coverage

craft_complexity.極簡: a fine jewelry photo where the setting around the center stone is extremely simple and plain — a basic four-prong or six-prong solitaire with no decorative elements, smooth plain metal shank, no milgrain, no engraving, no filigree, no gallery work, purely functional minimal metalwork
craft_complexity.普通: a fine jewelry photo with standard everyday setting complexity around the center stone — a classic prong or bezel setting with a plain polished gallery, simple shared-prong or channel shoulders, basic basket setting with no decorative details, straightforward workmanship without special ornamentation
craft_complexity.複雜: a fine jewelry photo with elaborate decorative setting work around the center stone — ornate gallery with cutout patterns, detailed basket or crown setting with milgrain edges, pave-set halo with diamond melee framing, engraved or textured metal band, split shank with diamond accents, visible intricate metalwork craftsmanship
craft_complexity.極複雜: a fine jewelry photo with extraordinarily intricate handcrafted setting — multi-tiered cathedral mount, lace-like filigree metalwork, deeply carved relief sculpture on the mount, openwork gallery with multiple layers, antique or Art Deco style architectural setting with complex geometric patterns, the metalwork itself is a work of art independent of the gemstone
